cases.old_assumption: Every slash-like source or Markdown string is a private path.
cases.expected: Opaque routes, URLs, arithmetic and source literals remain intact; structural paths remain constrained.

cases.old_assumption: A self-consistent-looking receipt is sufficient to admit arbitrary paths.
cases.expected: Structural absolute paths and forged classification counts are rejected.

cases.old_assumption: A new fixed-schema field can silently inherit an opaque classification.
cases.expected: Unknown fixed fields cannot produce a passed structural receipt, including non-string values.

cases.old_assumption: Delegating additive inventory JSON either forbids benign text or disables nested path checks.
cases.expected: The declared namespace preserves opaque additions while rejecting machine-local structural paths.

cases.old_assumption: Resolved local roots are necessary to explain rejected context paths.
cases.expected: API, CLI and MCP return safe path-policy failure records without resolved roots.

cases.old_assumption: Lexical and resolved spellings of the same trusted output root are distinct directories.
cases.expected: Aliases preserve publication commitments without allowing outside commitments.

cases.old_assumption: Canonical bytes and a matching self-digest establish currentness.
cases.expected: Independent live reconciliation detects substituted source, repository, knowledge, generator, freshness, response, delivery and path-policy facets.

cases.old_assumption: Reconciliation proves the packet carries the request the consumer intended.
cases.expected: Currentness and basis equality remain distinct from the caller's expected-request check.

cases.old_assumption: Losing native artifacts can become an unchanged successful response.
cases.expected: Availability loss is stale and unavailable knowledge does not acquire currentness.

cases.old_assumption: Matching snapshot evidence is equivalent to freshly evaluated knowledge.
cases.expected: Structural validation and caller-basis equality leave currentness unevaluated.

cases.old_assumption: Evidence remains current after source or consumed wiki state changes.
cases.expected: The official complete reconciliation policy detects changed live evidence.

cases.old_assumption: A successful early read permits publication after an anchor changes.
cases.expected: Source and wiki mutation before final encoding abort packet return.

cases.old_assumption: A captured view remains usable when individual manifest, surface, knowledge, governance, verification or Markdown inputs change.
cases.expected: A mutation of each named wiki anchor before packet return is a context-read-mutated failure.

cases.old_assumption: Source selection can broaden between reads without invalidating the captured source basis.
cases.expected: A changed selection control is rejected before excluded source content is read.

cases.old_assumption: A nonexistent source is equivalent to an existing empty source tree.
cases.expected: Missing/non-directory sources are explicit unavailable failures across packet adapters.

cases.old_assumption: Validation or reconciliation may silently refresh artifacts or invoke a provider.
cases.expected: Official reconciliation performs no writes/provider/plugin calls.

cases.old_assumption: Structural validation or caller-basis comparison requires reading local source or consulting a provider.
cases.expected: Offline consumers perform no file/network I/O and never infer live currentness from equality.

cases.old_assumption: A previous built marker remains valid after committed outputs change.
cases.expected: A regenerated publication stales the previous build until its matching marker is supplied.

cases.old_assumption: Missing, tampered or mismatched publication metadata can be treated as complete.
cases.expected: Official site consumers reject malformed or mismatched metadata.

cases.old_assumption: An attached identifier proves arbitrary bytes came from its original body.
cases.expected: Truncated/noncanonical data and transplanted packet IDs are rejected.

cases.old_assumption: A previously valid ID can be attached to a changed body.
cases.expected: Digest/body mismatch is malformed, regardless of the supplied ID's provenance.

cases.old_assumption: Locally consistent replacement necessarily preserves the independent consumer's expectation.
cases.expected: Both owner-produced states may be structurally valid; independent expected basis and live source reveal mismatch.

cases.old_assumption: Self-contained local bytes universally detect complete same-owner rollback/recreation.
cases.expected: Identical recreated content can retain packet identity; no owner-resistant or monotonic-history claim follows.

cases.old_assumption: A signature made with an owner-controlled key establishes an external witness.
cases.expected: Local signing cannot admit unsupported packet assurance levels.
